candidates_today_dedup_v.definition:
WITH real_ensemble AS (
  SELECT 
    period,
    timestamp as ts_utc,
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', timestamp, 'Asia/Shanghai') as ts_cst,
    p_star_ens,
    vote_ratio,
    n_votes
  FROM `wprojectl.pc28.p_ensemble_today_norm_v`
  WHERE DATE(timestamp, 'Asia/Shanghai') = CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Shanghai')
),
signal_evaluation AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    CASE 
      WHEN p_star_ens >= 0.60 THEN 'Gold'
      WHEN p_star_ens >= 0.50 THEN 'Silver'
      WHEN p_star_ens >= 0.40 THEN 'Bronze'
      ELSE NULL
    END as tier_candidate,
    (1.95 * p_star_ens - 1.0) > 0 as keyB,
    FALSE as veto
  FROM real_ensemble
)
SELECT 
  CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Shanghai') as day_id,
  period,
  ts_utc,
  ts_cst,
  'normal' as session,
  tier_candidate,
  p_star_ens,
  vote_ratio,
  keyB,
  veto
FROM signal_evaluation
WHERE tier_candidate IS NOT NULL
  AND keyB = TRUE
ORDER BY ts_utc DESC

kpi_daily.definition:
WITH acts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(ts_act_utc,'Asia/Shanghai') AS day_id,
    period_norm, ts_act_utc, tier_final,
    take_flag, pred_target, pred_side, ev_unit
  FROM `wprojectl.pc28.actions_dedup_today_v`
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    a.day_id, a.tier_final, a.take_flag,
    -- 命中口径：按target自动识别
    CASE
      WHEN a.pred_target = 'OE' THEN 
        CASE WHEN a.pred_side='EVEN' AND l.is_even THEN 1
             WHEN a.pred_side!='EVEN' AND NOT l.is_even THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END
      WHEN a.pred_target = 'SZ' THEN 
        CASE WHEN a.pred_side='LARGE' AND l.sum>=14 THEN 1
             WHEN a.pred_side!='LARGE' AND l.sum<14 THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 
        CASE WHEN a.pred_side='EVEN' AND l.is_even THEN 1
             WHEN a.pred_side!='EVEN' AND NOT l.is_even THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END
    END AS hit,
    a.ev_unit
  FROM acts a
  JOIN `wprojectl.pc28.labels_today_v` l USING (period_norm)
  WHERE a.take_flag = TRUE            -- ✅ on-taken
),
agg_g AS (
  SELECT day_id,
         AVG(CAST(hit AS FLOAT64)) AS acc_on_taken,
         AVG(ev_unit) AS avg_ev,
         COUNT(*) AS n_taken
  FROM joined GROUP BY day_id
),
coverage_data AS (
  SELECT coverage_global FROM `wprojectl.pc28.coverage_today_v`
)
SELECT
  g.day_id,
  g.acc_on_taken AS acc_global,
  g.avg_ev AS ev_global,
  c.coverage_global,
  -- 交通灯判色（按覆盖_today_v）
  CASE
    WHEN g.acc_on_taken >= 0.6 AND g.avg_ev >= 0.03 AND c.coverage_global >= 0.25 AND c.coverage_global <= 0.40 THEN 'GREEN'
    WHEN g.avg_ev < 0 THEN 'RED'
    ELSE 'YELLOW'
  END AS traffic_light
FROM agg_g g
CROSS JOIN coverage_data c
